connect.title: Connect {client} to ChatPLUS
connect.description: {client} workspace “{team}” asks for access to a ChatPLUS workspace.
connect.noWorkspaces: You need to be an administrator of a ChatPLUS workspace to connect it.
connect.permissionInbox: read and reply to every conversation in this ChatPLUS workspace, and assign or archive conversations
connect.permissionContacts: read every contact in this workspace and update their fields and tags
connect.permissionIntegrations: send leads from your bots to {client} (ChatPLUS adds one webhook for this)
connect.replaceNote: A workspace can be linked to one {client} workspace. Linking again replaces the previous link.
connect.revokeNote: To disconnect, use “Disconnect” in {client}. Deleting the {client} API key in ChatPLUS settings blocks its access, but lead sending stops only after {client} notices the deleted key or you disconnect there.
connect.invalidTitle: This connect link is not valid
connect.invalidDescription: Start the connection again from {client}, or contact support.
connect.errorNotAdmin: Only a workspace administrator can connect it.
connect.errorSupportSession: A support session cannot connect a workspace.
connect.errorInvalidRequest: The connect request is not valid. Start again from the other application.
